{{TOC limit|2}}

== Background ==
The 2022 season started with ''Bare Knuckle Fighting Championship Fight Night: Jackson''. BKFC is available on PPV all over the world and on [[FITE TV]].<ref>{{cite web |url=https://twitter.com/FiteTV/status/1337579280381915136|title=Who is ready for the bareknucklefc debut of paige vanzant?|publisher=twitter.com/FiteTV/}}</ref>

'''''BKFC KnuckleMania 2''''' was a [[bare-knuckle fighting]] event held by Bare Knuckle Fighting Championship on February 19, 2022, at the Jackson Convention Complex in [[Hollywood, Florida]], [[United States|USA]].

===Background===
The main event featured a world title fight for the BKFC Lightweight Championship between the champion Luis Palomino and the challenger Martin Brown.<ref>{{cite web |last1=Phillips |first1=Keith |title=Vicksburg's Brown to fight Luis Palomino for the Lightweight Title in February. |url=https://vicksburgnews.com/vicksburgs-brown-to-fight-luis-palomino-for-the-lightweight-title-in-february/ |website=vicksburgnews.com |date=15 January 2022 |access-date=10 June 2022}}</ref>

The event featured the BKFC debut of former UFC fighters [[Chad Mendes]]<ref>{{cite web |last1=King |first1=Kristen |title=Chad Mendes set for bare-knuckle boxing debut at BKFC KnuckleMania II in February |url=https://www.bloodyelbow.com/2022/1/11/22878493/chad-mendes-set-for-bare-knuckle-boxing-debut-at-bkfc-knucklemania-ii-in-february-boxing-news |website=bloodyelbow.com |date=11 January 2022 |access-date=10 June 2022}}</ref> and [[Mike Perry (fighter)|Mike Perry]].<ref>{{cite web |last1=Raimondi |first1=Marc |title=Mike Perry, former UFC brawler, signs with Bare Knuckle FC |url=https://www.espn.com/mma/story/_/id/32481174/controversial-former-ufc-fighter-mike-perry-signs-bkfc |website=espn.com |date=26 October 2021 |access-date=10 June 2022}}</ref>

The event also featured a fight for the vacant BKFC Women's Flyweight Championship Christine Ferea and Britain Hart.<ref>{{cite web |last1=Heck |first1=Mike |title=Britain Hart vs. Christine Ferea inaugural flyweight title fight set for Feb. 19 'Knucklemania' event |url=https://www.mmafighting.com/2022/1/13/22881948/britain-hart-vs-christine-ferea-inaugural-flyweight-title-fight-set-for-feb-19-knucklemania-event |website=mmafighting.com |date=13 January 2022 |access-date=10 June 2022}}</ref>

'''Bonus awards'''

The following fighters were awarded bonuses:<ref name="bkfckn2">{{cite web|url=https://www.instagram.com/p/CaQPYJbpaka|title=BKFC Knucklemania 2 Bonuses|date=February 22, 2022|author=BKFC|publisher=instagram.com}}</ref>

'''''BKFC Fight Night New York 2: Grant vs. Retic''''' (also known as '''''BKFC Fight Night 6''''') was a [[bare-knuckle fighting]] event held by Bare Knuckle Fighting Championship on March 12, 2022 at the Seneca Allegany Resort & Casino Event Center in [[Miami]], [[United States|USA]].

===Background===
The event featured the promotion's return to New York.

A BKFC Bantamweight Championship fight between the defending champion Johnny Bedford and Jarod Grant was Originally scheduled to headline the card.<ref>{{cite web |last1=Djilas |first1=Danilo |title=Johnny Bedford vs Jarod Grant for Bantamweight Title Official for BKFC Fight Night New York 2 |url=https://mmasucka.com/2022/01/21/johnny-bedford-vs-jarod-grant-for-bantamweight-title-official-for-bkfc-fight-night-new-york-2/ |website=mmasucka.com |date=21 January 2022 |access-date=10 June 2022}}</ref> However, Bedford had to pull out from the bout due to injury. Anthony Retic steep in on late notice to face Grant for the interim BKFC Bantamweight Championship.<ref>{{cite web |last1=Morfin |first1=Bjorn |title=Johnny Bedford Out, Antony Retic to face Jarod Grant for Interim Bantamweight Strap |url=https://mymmanews.com/johnny-bedford-out-antony-retic-to-face-jarod-grant-for-interim-bantamweight-strap/ |website=mymmanews.com |date=3 March 2022 |access-date=10 June 2022}}</ref>

A middleweight bout between former [[Bellator MMA]] turned UFC fighter [[Michael Page (fighter)|Michael Page]] and former [[Ultimate Fighting Championship|UFC]] fighter [[Mike Perry (fighter)|Mike Perry]] served as the event headliner.<ref>{{cite web |last1=Baldwin |first1=Nick |title=Michael Page, Mike Perry set for BKFC match in August |url=https://www.thescore.com/mma/news/2371362/amp |website=thescore.com |access-date=10 June 2022}}</ref><ref>{{cite web |last1=Pettry |first1=Jay |title=Michael 'Venom' Page vs. Mike Perry Bare-Knuckle Brawl Set as BKFC 27 Main Event |url=https://www.sherdog.com/news/news/Michael-Venom-Page-vs-Mike-Perry-BareKnuckle-Brawl-Set-as-BKFC-27-Main-Event-187082 |website=sherdog.com |access-date=10 June 2022}}</ref> This is the second time in BKFC history that a bout went to a sixth overtime round.

The fight between [[Paige VanZant]] and Charisa Sigala was expected to serve as the co-main event. The fight was canceled few days ahead of the event and was subsequently rescheduled to take place at BKFC 31 on October 15.<ref>{{cite news |last1=Martin |first1=Damon |title=Paige VanZant pulled from BKFC London card, fight with Charisa Sigala rescheduled for October |url=https://www.mmafighting.com/2022/8/16/23308427/paige-vanzant-pulled-from-bkfc-london-card-fight-with-charisa-sigala-expected-to-be-rescheduled |access-date=17 August 2022 |work=MMA Fighting |date=16 August 2022 |language=en}}</ref><ref name=pvz31>{{cite web|url=https://www.bareknuckle.tv/news/vanzant-sigala-battle-moved-to-bkfc-31-on-oct-15-in-denver-co:ef2d341b-ce94-456c-8225-17b8cb63c8fe|title= VanZant-Sigala battle moved to BKFC 31 on Oct. 15 in Denver, CO|date=August 16, 2022|work=[[Bare Knuckle Fighting Championship]]}}</ref>

===Background===
Having been moved from BKFC 27, the bout between [[Paige VanZant]] and Charisa Sigala was supposed to be the headliner of this event.<ref name=pvz31 /> However, Sigala stepped up on short notice to replace Fani Peloumpi at BKFC 29, leaving VanZant without an opponent.<ref>{{cite web|url=https://www.bareknuckle.tv/news/there-was-no-hesitation-charisa-sigala-steps-up-on-short-notice-to-battle-hart-beltran-for-bkfc-gold:acaadf68-d732-4ccd-aa3b-6fd749b051af|title= "There was no hesitation": Charisa Sigala steps up on short notice to battle Hart Beltran for BKFC gold|date=September 9, 2022|work=[[Bare Knuckle Fighting Championship]]}}</ref>

The event was then ultimately headlined by Mike Richman vs. Isaac Doolittle for the interim [[Bare Knuckle Fighting Championship#Light Heavyweight Championship|BKFC Light Heavyweight Championship]].

[[Melvin Guillard]] was initially scheduled to face Evgeny Kurdanov, but he was ultimately not allowed to compete after Colorado Combative Sports Commission denied his license on the grounds of health concerns.<ref>{{cite web|url=https://mmajunkie.usatoday.com/2022/10/bkfc-colorado-melvin-guillard-denied-by-commission-health-concerns|title=Colorado won't allow Melvin Guillard to fight at BKFC 31 over safety concerns|date=October 7, 2022|work=[[MMAjunkie.com]]|author=Simon Samano}}</ref>
